title: College Basketball
description:
Boise State vs. Nebraska
The Boise State Broncos face the No. 25 Nebraska Cornhuskers for an NCAA Division I game in South Dakota. Boise State rides a three-game win streak alongside guard Aginaldo Neto, and Nebraska also rides a three-game win streak with Pryce Sandfort.

title: Women's College Basketball
description:
Princeton at UCLA
The UCLA Bruins meet Princeton Tigers at Pauley Pavilion. UCLA relies on 40 rebounds and 11 steals from a 76-44 win on Nov 12, while Princeton counts on 52.1 percent shooting from an 81-74 victory on Nov 10 to capture a non-conference road win.

title: College Basketball
description:
Coastal Carolina at Wisconsin
The Wisconsin Badgers host the Coastal Carolina Chanticleers at Kohl Center in Madison. Jaylen Cross leads Coastal Carolina with approximately six rebounds and over two assists, while Braeden Carrington leads Wisconsin with 15 points.

title: College Basketball
description:
Alcorn State at Maryland
The Maryland Terrapins host the Alcorn State Braves at XFINITY Center in College Park. Alcorn State relies on Calvin Sirmans III who leads the team in points and assists, while Pharrel Payne leads Maryland with over 20 points per game.

title: College Basketball
description:
Western Illinois at Minnesota
The Leathernecks (1-3) visit the Golden Gophers (4-0) at the Barn by Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Minnesota. Western Illinois enters this matchup after falling 91-83 to Cal State Bakersfield, while Minnesota seeks a fifth straight victory.

title: College Basketball
description:
Long Beach State at UCLA
The No. 9 UCLA Bruins (3-0) host the Long Beach State Beach (1-2) at Pauley Pavilion. Long Beach State defeated Pacific 62-59 and earned their first win this season, while UCLA aims for a fourth straight win behind Nikola Kusturica's 18.3 points.
